artists.name: Kate Lavender
artists.bio: Based in Keswick, Kate Lavender established North Lakes Stained Glass in 2021, drawing inspiration from the Lake District's emotive landscapes and nature. With over 30 years of experience in Tiffany foiling and lead light techniques, she creates unique pieces using reclaimed and textured glass. Her work, recently featured on BBC's Make It At Market, includes bespoke commissions, restoration, and creative workshops.
